caption:
A worry list without structure gives your brain permission to revisit every item on repeat. The Filter List forces a verdict on each one — act or let go.

The Filter List is from the free 7-Day Overthinking Detox — DM "DETOX" to get it.

Save this for the next time you make a list and feel worse. Send it to someone whose worry lists never end.
